title: Rome Adventure
description: An art student (Troy Donahue), his ex-girlfriend (Angie Dickinson), a librarian (Suzanne Pleshette) and a local charmer cross paths in Italy.

title: The Bobo
description: An impresario will let a clumsy matador (Peter Sellers) sing at his theater if he seduces the biggest flirt (Britt Ekland) in Barcelona.

title: Queen Bee
description: A boozing Atlanta millionaire's (Barry Sullivan) wicked wife (Joan Crawford) acts charming to people at their mansion.

title: The Nanny
description: A bratty British boy accuses his frumpy nanny (Bette Davis) of awful things.

title: The Honeymoon Killers
description: After meeting through a lonely hearts club, Martha Beck (Shirley Stoler) and Ray Fernandez (Tony Lo Bianco) swindle and murder rich, lonely women.

title: Cast a Dark Shadow
description: An Englishman (Dirk Bogarde) gets away with killing his rich old wife, then tries it with a savvy widow (Margaret Lockwood).

title: Diabolique
description: A wife (Vera Clouzot) and a mistress (Simone Signoret) conspire to murder the brutal headmaster (Paul Meurisse) of a school for boys, then the body disappears.

title: Obsession
description: A London psychiatrist suspects that his wife is having yet another affair; when he confirms it, he takes her lover prisoner and taunts his wife about the other man's condition.

title: Strangers on a Train
description: A psychopath (Robert Walker) and a tennis player (Farley Granger) meet in a club car and plot that each will murder someone for the other.

title: The Browning Version
description: A British schoolmaster (Michael Redgrave) retires with dignity, despite illness and his unfaithful wife (Jean Kent).

title: The Actress
description: Supported by her mother, a New Englander (Jean Simmons) finally tells her salty father (Spencer Tracy) she wants to be an actress.

title: Tea and Sympathy
description: Marked as a sissy, a preppie turns to his housemaster's understanding wife.

title: Look Back in Anger
description: A man vents his rage against society by lashing out at his demoralized wife, his best friend and his eager mistress.

title: Sweet Bird of Youth
description: Florida gigolo Chance Wayne (Paul Newman) brings home ex-screen queen Alexandra Del Lago (Geraldine Page).

title: The Connection
description: A would-be documentary filmmaker pays drug addicts for the opportunity to record them as they await a heroin shipment.

title: Lon Chaney: A Thousand Faces
description: The life and work of the silent horror-movie star and makeup artist.

title: Man of a Thousand Faces
description: Makeup genius and actor Lon Chaney (James Cagney) marries two women (Dorothy Malone, Jane Greer) and stars in silent classics like "The Phantom of the Opera."

title: The Phantom of the Opera
description: A mad, masked composer holds a singer captive in the catacombs beneath the Paris Opera House and grooms her for stardom.

title: He Who Gets Slapped
description: A scientist's faith in humanity is lost when he discovers that his wife is in love with his best friend.

title: Laugh, Clown, Laugh
description: A circus clown (Lon Chaney) adopts an orphan (Loretta Young), then falls in love with her when she grows into womanhood.

title: The Blackbird
description: A disabled bishop (Lon Chaney) secretly masterminds a vast underworld organization.

title: Return From Nowhere
description: A man uses dream therapy to recover lost memories.

title: Village of the Damned
description: British parents (George Sanders, Barbara Shelley) realize their son is one of 12 evil alien children born in their village.

title: Children of the Damned
description: British researchers (Ian Hendry, Alan Badel) try to study six alien children with high IQs and eyes that paralyze.

title: Batman and Robin
description:
S01 E14 — Batman vs. Wizard
Batman and Robin close in on the Wizard's identity after the villain is foiled in his attempt to steal the plans for an advanced airplane.

title: Dr. Kildare's Victory
description: Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) supports Kildare's (Lew Ayres) crusade against their hospital's deal with a rival hospital.

title: Popeye the Sailor
description:
Ghosks Is the Bunk
Bluto makes the house appear haunted, after Olive reads Popeye and Bluto a ghost story.

title: Billy Rose's Jumbo
description: A girl (Doris Day) and her father (Jimmy Durante) unknowingly hire a rival's son (Stephen Boyd) to help them save their tiny circus.

title: Hell Drivers
description: An ex-convict takes a job as a construction-supply trucker, where he finds himself torn between beating the foreman's driving record and exposing his crooked schemes.

title: The Little Shop of Horrors
description: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.

title: Monsieur Verdoux
description: A Paris bank clerk (Charles Chaplin) woos, weds and then kills rich women to support his ailing wife and son.

title: Out of the Past
description: A private eye (Robert Mitchum) cannot seem to get away from a gambler (Kirk Douglas) and his no-good girlfriend (Jane Greer).

title: The Set-Up
description: An aging boxer (Robert Ryan) leaves his crying wife (Audrey Totter), then crosses the street for a fixed fight.

title: Loophole
description: An investigator (Charles McGraw) hounds an innocent bank teller (Barry Sullivan) fired for robbing the till.

title: The Great Santini
description: A teenager stands up to his father, a gung-ho peacetime Marine pilot who runs his family like boot camp.

title: The Betsy
description: An auto tycoon (Laurence Olivier) spites his corporate heir (Robert Duvall) by having a test driver (Tommy Lee Jones) build a bold new car.

title: Woman of the Year
description: Sam Craig, a New York sportswriter marries Tess Harding, a political columnist whose career comes first.

title: Designing Woman
description: A married sportswriter (Gregory Peck) and fashion designer (Lauren Bacall) have clashing friends.

title: Loophole
description: An investigator (Charles McGraw) hounds an innocent bank teller (Barry Sullivan) fired for robbing the till.

title: Operation Crossbow
description: A British commando (George Peppard) and his team drop into Germany and pose as scientists to pinpoint a Nazi rocket base.

title: It's Always Fair Weather
description: A talk-show staffer (Cyd Charisse) puts a fight manager (Gene Kelly), adman (Dan Dailey) and cook on TV 10 years after they parted as GIs.

title: Ninotchka
description: A playboy (Melvyn Douglas) charms a Russian envoy (Greta Garbo) sent to fetch three wayward comrades in Paris.

title: Deep Valley
description: A shy California farm girl (Ida Lupino) falls in love with a fugitive (Dane Clark) from a chain gang.

title: All the President's Men
description: The Washington Post's Bob Woodward (Robert Redford) and Carl Bernstein (Dustin Hoffman) tie the Watergate break-in to the White House.

title: The Manchurian Candidate
description: A Korean War hero's (Laurence Harvey) commanding officer (Frank Sinatra) discovers he and his platoon were brainwashed.

title: The Battleship Potemkin
description: Sergei Eisenstein's classic film depicts the mutiny aboard a czarist battleship during the failed revolution of 1905.

title: Three Colors: Blue
description: A Frenchwoman (Juliette Binoche) tries to withdraw from life after her daughter and composer husband die in a car crash.

title: Three Colors: White
description: Divorced and ruined in Paris, a Polish hairdresser (Zbigniew Zamachowski) gets even with his French ex-wife (Julie Delpy).
